content.about: Trinidad and Tobago is a Caribbean nation near Venezuela. Its Carnival is famous. The steelpan was invented here. Pitch Lake is the largest natural asphalt lake.

standout.text: Trinidad and Tobago invented the steelpan, the only acoustic instrument invented in the 20th century.

didYouKnow: Pitch Lake is the largest natural asphalt deposit.
Calypso and soca come from here.
